notes.kirungi: Ejok: good, fine, nice. Also used alone to say “good!”.

guidebook.intro: Colours and describing things. Adjectives come after the noun and agree with it.

tips.title: Arengan, akwangan
body: **Arengan** red, **akiryon** black, **akwangan** white, **akijani** green, **ayelo** yellow. **Ebulu** (blue) and **ekahawia** (brown) are borrowed.

tips.title: Big, small, good
body: **Epolon** big, **ediit** small, **ejok** good, **ititaŋ** new, **akaru** old. They follow the noun: **etogo epolon**, a big house.

culture.title: Cattle colours
body: Like other Nilotic herders, the Iteso have many words for cattle colours and patterns. A man could be known by the colour of his favourite ox.
